description: pixel art, a sealed pack of playing cards in portrait orientation seen straight from the front, a wrapper of dark brown tree bark paper like the back of the cards, the top and the bottom edge crimped in a small zigzag seam, a thin gold border line with small gold filigree curls in the corners, in the centre one glowing pale ice-blue faceted crystal with soft blue light around it, a small red wax seal on the top seam, symmetrical, no text, no numbers, the pack fills the whole image
